_comment: AXI tap settings for the CVA6 SoC. This file is DV configuration, not
a description of the RTL: nothing here is read from or driven by the
design, so changing a setting cannot move a check. The tb wires the
physical signals; every decision about what is monitored, how it is
named, filtered and logged is made here.
Edit this file to change tap behaviour. A tap listed here is built only
if the tb published a matching interface as axi_vif_<name>; a tap the
tb publishes but this file omits is not built at all, so this list is
log_level: UVM_NONE | UVM_LOW | UVM_MEDIUM | UVM_HIGH | UVM_FULL
addr_lo/addr_hi: inclusive window; transactions outside are not logged.
regions: address -> name, printed alongside the address.

axi_taps.name: dm_sba
axi_taps.description: Debug Module System Bus Access master

axi_taps.name: dm_slave
axi_taps.description: Hart accesses to the Debug Module: ROM fetches, flag writes, data registers
